title: Win the Talent War: From Offer to First Paycheck
summary: Win the talent war: Warp links Ashby, Offers and Checkr so employee onboarding automation runs from accepted offer to first paycheck, with no re-keying.
body_markdown:
Hiring is expensive right now, and in some corners of tech it’s getting more expensive by the week. Last week,[The Wall Street Journal](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/companies-dole-out-mega-paydays-and-luxury-trips-to-compete-for-ai-talent-3b3a7792) reported that companies are handing out mega paydays, luxury trips, and $30,000 referral bonuses to win AI talent. Serval, one of the companies highlighted in that story, is also a Warp customer.


“Serval is growing fast. We’ll go to great lengths to land the right person, and Warp makes sure that effort pays off,” said Carlos Lezama, Head of Talent at Serval. “Warp integrates with the Serval platform to handle the paperwork, payroll, and compliance that come with every new hire, so the people we fought for show up on day one ready to move at our speed.”


Once you’ve won the candidate, the last thing you want to do is lose momentum between their “yes” and their first paycheck. Today we’re making it faster and easier to connect the whole stretch from offer to paid employee, all in Warp.


## The gap between "yes" and day one


For most growing companies, the moment a candidate says “yes,” a relay race across tools kicks off. The offer letter lives in a doc, someone emails it, chases the signature, then opens a background-check vendor in another tab. When the candidate accepts, someone else re-types their name, salary, department, and start date into the HR system, and later into payroll. A manual onboarding checklist gets created ad hoc and distributed.


Each handoff is a chance for a typo, a delay, or a candidate wondering whether the company they just said yes to has it together. For a founder or People leader at a 50-person company hiring fast, it's also hours of ops work that nobody planned for.


## Employee onboarding automation: all in one flow in Warp


**Ashby, connected.** If you recruit in[Ashby, Warp's native integration](https://www.warp.co/integrations/ashby) syncs candidates, jobs and offer details, including salary, department and location, into Warp. It maps your Ashby departments and locations to Warp and prefills onboarding, so your new hire's record starts complete.


**Offers, revamped.** Create and send offers right from Warp using your own templates. Every live offer sits in one list, where you can resend, update, extend the deadline, copy the link, or void it. When the candidate accepts, their details flow into onboarding and payroll without anyone re-entering them.


**Background checks, started from the offer.** With[Checkr](https://www.warp.co/integrations/checkr) integrated directly in Warp, you can kick off a background check right from the offer.


**Day one, already handled.** Build Onboarding Routines with[Warp Agent](https://www.warp.co/agent) , and a purpose-built AI agent chases down everything outstanding, sends Approve or Deny cards in Slack to the right managers, and assigns any extra documents. Every detail is handled, delegated, and assigned before your new hire arrives, so they can open their laptop and hit the ground sprinting.


From there, it's the Warp you already know: onboarding flows into payroll and compliance, so your new hire's first paycheck is accurate and on time.


### Who this is for


- **Founders and operators** who want a fast, polished candidate experience that flows into the employee experience with fewer tools to babysit.
- **Recruiters** who want a clean handoff without spreadsheets.
- **People leaders** who want one source of truth, Agent-led Onboarding workflows, and to eliminate hiccups.

You fought hard for the hire. Don't lose them between “yes” and day one.
